supervisor.value: Contacting a potential supervisor before applying is encouraged, though it is not stated as a requirement.
supervisor.quote: we encourage interested students to look over faculty research areas and email a potential supervisor for information before the application deadline

funding.value: Accepted PhD students receive full tuition support for six years, a stipend and health coverage.
funding.quote: Accepted PhD students in Biology receive full tuition support for six years, a competitive stipend, and health coverage.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 1, 2026; the official table prints no year.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: The page's 'competitive scores' (TOEFL 97, IELTS 7, Duolingo 125) are not minimums and are not used. Deadline is the PhD Fall column of the official application-deadlines table. The Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences also runs a Genetics, Molecular and Cellular Biology PhD; see the tufts--biomed record.
